title: Route TUI ignores active sprint projection
description: Evidence: apps/tui/src/loaders.ts sets activeProjectionSprintId to undefined and then selects the first sorted sprint, while the older loader reads active-sprint projections. Impact: the Sprint Board can show no active marker and select the wrong sprint.
acceptanceCriteria: Route TUI reads active-sprint projection or equivalent canonical state and selects/marks the active sprint, with a multi-sprint regression test.
